security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, localhost setup examples, and intentionally bad examples used for teaching. Two replay-history file write examples remain medium-risk because they can persist production histories without path validation or data-handling safeguards. No prompt-injection attempt or malicious execution intent was found.

remediation.issue: Production workflow histories may contain sensitive payloads and metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to redact histories, limit exports to approved environments, exclude history files from artifacts, and define retention rules.

remediation.issue: Replay export examples write to caller-controlled or workflow-derived file paths.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain writes to a dedicated directory, sanitize workflow IDs, reject path separators, and avoid overwriting existing files by default.

semantic_findings.description: Replay guidance fetches production workflow histories and writes them to local or CI files without redaction, retention, or access-control warnings. Temporal histories can contain payloads and metadata that may be sensitive.

content.value_statement: Temporal workflow tests need deterministic patterns across unit, integration, and replay scenarios. This skill guides pytest setup, time-skipping, activity mocks, and replay checks.
actual_capabilities: Explains pytest fixtures for Temporal WorkflowEnvironment and ActivityEnvironment.
Shows time-skipping patterns for long-running workflow tests.
Guides mocked activity testing for integration scenarios.
Describes replay testing against workflow histories for determinism.
Provides local Temporal server setup guidance with Docker Compose.
Outlines CI coverage and replay test workflows.
limitations: It does not execute tests or install Temporal dependencies by itself.
Examples require adaptation to each project structure and workflow API.
Replay guidance assumes authorized access to workflow histories.
Production history exports need separate data protection controls.

use_cases.title: Create Workflow Unit Tests
use_cases.description: Build fast pytest coverage for workflow logic using time-skipping and isolated Temporal test environments.

use_cases.title: Validate Integration Paths
use_cases.description: Test workflow behavior with mocked activities, controlled failures, retries, signals, and queries.

use_cases.title: Check Deployment Compatibility
use_cases.description: Use replay tests and CI workflows to catch non-deterministic changes before production deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Temporal Python project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan pytest coverage for a Temporal Python workflow. Include unit tests, activity tests, fixtures, and expected assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Add Time-Skipping
prompt_templates.scenario: Testing workflows with timers or long waits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to test my Temporal Python workflow with time-skipping. Explain the fixture structure and how to verify timer behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Mock Activities
prompt_templates.scenario: Integration tests with external dependencies isolated.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design integration tests for a Temporal Python workflow with mocked activities. Cover success, retry, permanent failure, and compensation cases.

prompt_templates.title: Build Replay Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a replay testing strategy for Temporal Python deployments. Include history selection, CI gates, versioning checks, and data handling controls.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to test a workflow that waits 30 days before sending a reminder.
output_examples.output: A pytest plan using Temporal time-skipping, a workflow environment fixture, clear assertions, and no real 30-day delay.

output_examples.input: A team needs to validate a workflow that calls payment and notification activities.
output_examples.output: An integration test outline with mocked activities, retry checks, failure injection, and assertions for workflow results and side effects.

output_examples.input: A platform engineer wants replay checks before merging workflow changes.
output_examples.output: A CI-focused replay strategy covering representative histories, determinism failures, versioning review, and safeguards for production history files.

best_practices: Use time-skipping for workflow timers so tests stay fast and deterministic.
Mock external dependencies in integration tests and assert workflow-visible outcomes.
Protect production histories with redaction, limited access, and short retention.
anti_patterns: Calling live external APIs directly inside workflow code during tests.
Using production workflow histories in CI without data handling controls.
Relying only on end-to-end tests while skipping replay and unit coverage.

faq.question: What does this skill help test?
faq.answer: It helps test Temporal Python workflows, activities, integration behavior, replay compatibility, and local development setup.

faq.question: Does it require a running Temporal server?
faq.answer: Some integration and local setup examples use a server. Unit and time-skipping patterns can use Temporal testing utilities.

faq.question: Can it help with replay testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how replay tests validate deterministic behavior against saved workflow histories.

faq.question: Does it generate project-specific tests automatically?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and prompts. Users still need to adapt names, task queues, workflows, and activities.

faq.question: Is production history export safe by default?
faq.answer: No. Teams should redact sensitive data, restrict access, and avoid storing histories in public or long-lived artifacts.

faq.question: Which AI coding tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
